full_moon_party.CORRECTION: The guide's dates are WRONG. Kendwa Rocks' own 2026 calendar lists 24 Oct and 21 Nov 2026 (not 31 Oct / 28 Nov). Full moons: Mon 26 Oct 2026 04:12 UTC, Tue 24 Nov 2026 14:53 UTC (US Naval Observatory). Both party Saturdays fall BEFORE the full moon, so 'the first Saturday after the full moon' is disproved; the calendar matches 'the Saturday nearest the full moon'. The venue never writes the rule in words: print 'the Saturday nearest the full moon — check the venue's published calendar', and drop the dispute.
